description: Doc 34 · P4 programming-KB retrieval golden set. Each query is grounded in a manual actually ingested into knowledge/programming (verified on disk: docTitles + tokens + pages exist). A retrieved top-K chunk is a HIT when its docTitle/sourcePath contains any expectDocContains entry OR its text contains any expectKeywords entry (case-insensitive) — mirrors scripts/ai-kb/eval-rag.mjs isHit. vendor scopes retrieval to that corpus. Covers all 6 ingested vendors (universal-robots, zmotion, mitsubishi, omron, fanuc, delta) + one multilingual (vi) query + one unfiltered query.
